summary: Cadeler A/S announced a share buy-back programme of up to NOK 7.6 million (≈EUR 700,000) on Form 6-K. The programme runs from 27 May to 5 June 2026 and is authorized by shareholders at the April 21, 2026 general meeting. Up to 105,275 shares (DKK 1.00 nominal) may be repurchased, subject to volume and price constraints under EU Safe Harbour Rules. The buy-back is for employee share-based incentive obligations, managed by an independent lead manager. As a modest, self-funded capital return with no premium or tender, the risk-arb angle is negligible; watch execution pace and any early suspension.
